about.title: The Story Behind Ceylon Experience
about.p1: I was born and raised right here in Kalutara — a town where the golden river meets the deep blue ocean. For over 10 years, I have been welcoming visitors from across the world and sharing with them the real Sri Lanka — not just the famous landmarks, but the hidden beaches, the roadside king coconut stalls, the fishermen's villages, and the warmth of our people.
about.p2: I created Ceylon Experience with one simple goal: to give every traveler a genuine, joyful, and stress-free journey. Whether it is a breezy Tuk-Tuk ride through Kalutara's coconut-lined back roads or a full-day adventure across the South Coast in my comfortable A/C van — I treat every guest like a friend, not a fare.
about.p3: Fluent in both English and Russian, I make sure that every guest — whether from London, Moscow, Berlin, or Sydney — feels completely comfortable, heard, and taken care of from the first message to the final drop-off. This is not just a job for me. It is my passion.
about.feat1_desc: Easily communicate, ask questions, and learn local stories in your preferred language.
about.feat2_desc: Careful, defensive driving, well-maintained vehicles, and full traveler assistance.
about.feat3_desc: Visit hidden beaches, authentic eateries, and serene temples far from crowded tourist traps.
about.feat4_desc: No surprise fees, no pushy shopping stops — just honest local rates.

tours.title: Popular South Coast & Day Tours
tours.subtitle: All itineraries can be 100% customized to your schedule, preferences, and pace.
tours.tour1_desc: Explore the famous Kalutara Bodhiya Stupa, historic Richmond Castle, scenic Calido Beach lagoon, a peaceful Kalu Ganga boat cruise, and local fruit/spice markets.
tours.tour1_h1: Kalutara Bodhiya (World's only hollow Buddhist stupa)
tours.tour1_h3: Calido Beach where the river meets the ocean
tours.tour1_h4: Authentic tropical fruit & king coconut tasting
tours.tour2_desc: Cruise through the mystical mangrove tunnels of Madu Ganga, visit Cinnamon Island, receive fish therapy, meet baby sea turtles at Kosgoda, and relax at Bentota Beach.
tours.tour2_h1: Boat safari through 64 mangrove islands on Madu River
tours.tour2_h4: Bentota Golden Beach & optional water sports
tours.tour3_title: Galle Dutch Fort & Southern Coastal Wonders
tours.tour3_desc: Discover the 17th-century UNESCO Galle Fort, feed wild sea turtles in Hikkaduwa, photograph traditional Koggala stilt fishermen, and visit a Moonstone gemstone mine.
tours.tour3_h1: UNESCO World Heritage Galle Fort walking tour & lighthouse
tours.tour3_h2: Swim with and feed wild giant sea turtles at Hikkaduwa
tours.tour3_h3: Iconic stilt fishermen photography at Koggala
tours.tour3_h4: Unawatuna Japanese Peace Pagoda & jungle beach
tours.tour4_title: Mirissa Blue Whale Safari & Coconut Tree Hill
tours.tour4_desc: Embark on an early morning boat safari in the Indian Ocean to spot blue whales and dolphins, followed by lunch at Mirissa Beach and photos at Coconut Tree Hill.
tours.tour4_h1: Ethical Blue Whale & Spinner Dolphin watching boat tour
tours.tour4_h2: Famous Coconut Tree Hill panoramic viewpoint
tours.tour4_h3: Mirissa Beach seaside seafood lunch & chilling
tours.tour4_h4: Scenic coastal drive back with sunset stops
tours.tour5_title: Udawalawe Wild Elephant National Park Safari
tours.tour5_desc: Experience a private 4x4 open-top jeep safari inside Udawalawe National Park. See large herds of wild Asian elephants, water buffaloes, crocodiles, and exotic birds.
tours.tour5_h1: Guaranteed wild elephant sightings in natural habitat
tours.tour5_h2: Private open-top 4x4 Safari Jeep with expert tracker
tours.tour5_h4: Comfortable door-to-door A/C van transfer from Kalutara
tours.tour6_desc: Stress-free airport pickup or drop-off with flight tracking, welcome nameboard, toll highway drive, and door-to-door luggage assistance to all Kalutara & South Coast resorts.
tours.tour6_h1: Flight monitoring for delayed or early arrivals
tours.tour6_h2: Fast highway transfer avoiding city traffic
tours.tour6_h3: Chilled drinking water and spacious luggage room
tours.tour6_h4: Available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week

reviews.title: What Travelers Say About Our Trips
reviews.subtitle: Real experiences from guests from around the world.
reviews.r1_text: We had an amazing time! He picked us up from Anantara Kalutara in his comfortable van and took us to Galle Fort and turtle feeding at Hikkaduwa. Speaks fluent Russian, which was super helpful for my parents. Very polite and careful driver!
reviews.r2_text: The best guide in Kalutara! We took the Tuk-Tuk local tour on our first day and liked him so much we booked his van for Udawalawe Safari. Seeing wild elephants up close was breathtaking. Honest prices and great recommendations!
reviews.r3_text: Super service! Punctual airport transfer in the middle of the night, cold water ready in the van, and smooth driving on the highway. We also did the Madu River boat tour with him. Highly recommended to everyone visiting Sri Lanka!
reviews.r4_text: Friendly, joyful, and knowledgeable. Took us to the best authentic local curry restaurant where locals eat and showed us hidden beaches. You can trust him 100%!

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your tour.
faq.q1: How do I book a tour or ride with you?
faq.a1: The easiest and fastest way is via WhatsApp! Simply click any WhatsApp button on this site or send a message with your hotel name, desired date, and which tour you'd like. I will reply immediately with availability and pricing.
faq.q2: Do you speak Russian and English?
faq.a2: Yes, absolutely! I am fluent in both Russian (свободно говорю по-русски) and English, so we can chat and plan your holiday without any language difficulties.
faq.q3: Which hotels do you pick up from?
faq.a3: I pick up from all hotels, resorts, and guesthouses in Kalutara, Wadduwa, Maggona, Beruwala, and Bentota (e.g. Anantara, Avani, Tangerine, Royal Palms, Mermaid Hotel, Turyaa, Heritance Ayurveda, Cinnamon Bentota, etc.).
faq.q4: Can we customize our tour itinerary?
faq.a4: Yes, 100%! All tours are private and flexible. If you want to skip a stop, stay longer at the beach, stop for king coconut or tropical fruit, or add a specific attraction, we can tailor the itinerary exactly as you wish.
faq.q5: What is the difference between Tuk-Tuk and Van tours?
faq.a5: Tuk-Tuks are perfect for 1-3 people for local scenic trips (Kalutara, Bentota, markets, beaches) with open-air views. The A/C Van is ideal for up to 9 passengers with luggage for longer distances (Galle, Mirissa, Yala Safari, Sigiriya, Airport) with cool climate control and full luggage space.
faq.a6: You can pay in cash directly at the end of the tour in Sri Lankan Rupees (LKR), US Dollars (USD), Euros (EUR), or British Pounds (GBP). No advance deposit is needed for standard day tours.
